question: After failure containment and live proof, should exact allowlisted workspace-directory plugins be admitted to native Codex turns?
rationale: This intentionally expands which account-scoped plugin apps may be exposed to Codex turns, so the permanent product and trust-boundary policy requires explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Approve Narrow Admission
options.body: Allow exact configured IDs only, require existing installed and enabled state, retain the default-deny app policy, and never install workspace plugins from OpenClaw.

options.title: Keep Curated-Only
options.body: Retain the current native plugin marketplace boundary and decline workspace-directory support.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Admission
recommendation.body: Allow exact configured IDs only, require existing installed and enabled state, retain the default-deny app policy, and never install workspace plugins from OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available merged history is the revert that deliberately defined the current curated-only boundary.
